title: Helsinki Grotesk Pro / File Formats
slide_intent: Separate delivery formats so the same typographic family can be implemented appropriately in desktop and web environments.
strategic_value: Named font packages can reduce ambiguity when Helsinki hands work between designers and developers.
demonstration: Two columns list desktop OTF and variable TTF files at left and web WOFF2 and variable files at right.
practical_value: Use the intended environment’s package and verify actual filenames; the printed static lists repeat Medium rather than listing a Regular upright file.

content_islands.name: Desktop formats
content_islands.spec: Upper-left static filenames sit above the desktop variable file.

content_islands.name: Web formats
content_islands.spec: Right static filenames sit above the web variable TTF and WOFF2 files.

reference_purposes.Application: The page separates desktop and web delivery and lists static and variable filenames under each environment.
